entries.text: I feel tired from the night before and my brain is foggy . I’m having trouble focusing . My voice is raspy and my throat feels kind of sore . There’s some nervousness in my chest but other than that , I feel fine .

I currently feel kind of sick in my stomach . It feels like I might throw up but it never happens . I also feel tired , like I need a nap . I don’t really have the anxiety anymore . I’m just tired . That’s basically it though .

I feel very anxious and stressed right now . I’m thinking about what I have to get done and my future and also personal problems . It’s getting to me right now . It’s hard to focus on the things that matter so that’s adding to it .

I’m feeling decent right now . I feel a little behind in my day (which may translate to some stress) and a little distracted . I also feel hungry but dirty (I need a shower) . I also feel bloated . That’s basically it

I feel tensed up . My body (upper back , face , jaw) just feel really tense . I feel sort of annoyed (because of my brother) . I’m feeling hungry , and I’m starting to feel tired . The tense feeling is probably from some stress .

I’m feeling kind of overwhelmed right now . Kind of nervous and impatient . I want to do something fun but I know I need to concentrate and get work done on my laptop (personal duties) . I’m trying to stay positive but it’s hard . I feel a little down but I’m pushing through .

I’m feeling a pretty nervous feeling about various things . I also feel a hint of excitement and some confusion . My entire body feels really tense , like it needs to be massaged . My stomach also feels weird .
